text:
maria (Docs): FYI I opened a small PR to tidy up several console/observability samples — tracing hook example, cost/latency breakdown snippet, and one dead link. PTAL when you have a minute. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :wave:

jay (Eng): @maria thanks — will review. Is this purely docs, or do we need to change the SDK snippet to match the new trace API? :eyes:

maria (Docs): purely docs, but I tweaked the snippet to reflect the new `startTrace` helper we added in the SDK last week. I added a short note explaining the `traceId` field so people don't confuse it with request ids.

oliver (Platform): quick heads-up — I found a broken anchor in the dashboard page (`#cost-breakdown`) that the old example referenced. Looks like the header slug changed after the last restructure. I updated the link in the PR to `#cost-and-latency` and left a comment with the old -> new mapping.

maria (Docs): thanks @oliver — I adjusted the anchor text and added a redirect note for folks on the previous version. Also updated the sample metrics query to the new metric name `redwood.tokens.cost_usd` per recent telemetry renames. Example query I added:```sql
SELECT route, SUM(value) AS total_cost_usd
FROM metrics
WHERE metric = 'redwood.tokens.cost_usd'
  AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY total_cost_usd DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

jay (Eng): snippet looks good. One nit: use `GROUP BY route, service`? Otherwise different services with same route collide. Not a blocker though.

pm_tasha (PM): nice. Can we also add a short sentence calling out quantization/precision affecting the cost estimates? Customers keep asking why numbers shift after model/quant changes.

maria (Docs): added a 2-line note under the cost section about quantization and rounding; linked to the Optimize guide.

docs-bot: Deploy preview available — https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai (checks: lint, linkcheck, smoke). :rocket:

jay (Eng): skimmed the rendering, the tracing hook example renders fine. I left one inline suggestion about using triple-backticks for the JS snippet to preserve spacing.

maria (Docs): fixed formatting and responded to your inline. Also added an explicit `npm install @redwood/sdk@^1.3.0` callout so examples match shipped SDK.

ci-bot: CI passed for PR #482 (build: success, linkcheck: success, deploy-preview: ready).

jay (Eng): LGTM. :shipit:

maria (Docs): merging now. I'll open a small follow-up to backfill a redirect for the old anchor in case customers bookmarked it. Thanks everyone! :tada:

ci-bot: PR #482 merged by maria (Docs) at 1902103595.

maria (Docs): filed follow-up ticket INF-2213 to add the redirect/backfill and add unit tests to the linkcheck job.

oliver (Platform): great, thanks — helps our onboarding docs look much cleaner.

jay (Eng): nice and quick.
